data.name: Ardhendu
data.gender_notes: Ardhendu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The One Who Reaches the Summit
data.long_meaning: Ardhendu is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ardh’ meaning summit, peak, or top, and ‘indu’ meaning drop, rain, or lord. This name signifies someone who has reached the pinnacle of success or spiritual enlightenment. The name Ardhendu carries the meaning “The One Who Reaches the Summit” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ardhendu usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who reaches the summit and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the journey towards self-realization and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Ardhendu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One Who Reaches the Summit.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ardhendu total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

historical_references.reference: Ardhendu was a renowned Hindu sage mentioned in the Puranas, a collection of ancient Indian texts. He is believed to have lived during the Mahabharata epoch, around 3000-2000 BC.
historical_references.context: Renowned Hindu sage mentioned in the Puranas.

historical_references.reference: Ardhendu is also mentioned in the 13th-century Bengali literature as a great ascetic who lived in the forest and was revered by local villagers. He is known to have performed miraculous acts and was considered to be a manifestation of Lord Shiva.
historical_references.context: Great ascetic revered in Bengali literature.
